headline: Space Invaders' watch pilot stops freezing between kills
lede: The seat/attract autopilot used to stall up to 3.3 seconds while falling shots blocked its path. It now crosses behind their clocks and holds its ground instead of fleeing to the wrong wall — worst stall 197 -> 128 ticks, slowest wave-1 clear 1506 -> 1443, still 20/20 seeds untouched.

notes.text: Time-aware lane crossing: the pilot compares each bullet's hull-deep kill clock against its own traverse time, so it walks past a shot that will land too late to touch it.
HOLD, don't flee: an unreachable aim no longer sprints to the wall opposite the shots (that fallback once ran 500 ticks and let two invaders land unrifled).
Pins tightened 1600/220 -> 1500/150 — deeper than every measured deletion; 15/15 mutants die, watchcheck 322/322 in real Chrome.
Filed #3547: the README's 'no 100-point bonus life' line contradicts a shipped BONUS_LIFE_POINTS=100 — gap lines steer the never-dry picker, so it needs QA re-adjudication.

look.text: Seat WATCH on Space Invaders and watch it walk its shots
